update.comment: 1.7.0: C5 spread-day fall-back through vegetation groups (VegetationClass.FallbackGroup: Forest = Conifer, Hardwood; Non-forest = Shrub, Grass, Other) and a settable minimum of recorded fires per curve (CalibrationOption.MinimumFiresPerCurve, default 25, was a fixed 30).

action.item: ALTER TABLE lucasFireC2F_VegetationClass ADD COLUMN FallbackGroup TEXT
UPDATE lucasFireC2F_VegetationClass SET FallbackGroup = 'Forest' WHERE Name IN ('Conifer', 'Hardwood')
UPDATE lucasFireC2F_VegetationClass SET FallbackGroup = 'Non-forest' WHERE Name IN ('Shrub', 'Grass', 'Other')
ALTER TABLE lucasFireC2F_CalibrationOption ADD COLUMN MinimumFiresPerCurve INTEGER
